blockingIssues.description: Closing </superuser> tag is not filtered. Only <superuser> is replaced with [filtered], but </superuser> leaks through because the generic tag filter regex /<[a-zA-Z][^>]*>/g doesn't match tags starting with </. Result: sanitizeBookmarkText('<superuser>admin</superuser>') produces '[filtered]admin</superuser>'. The code comment on line 89-90 explicitly acknowledges this gap but didn't fix it.
blockingIssues.suggestedFix: Add .replace(/<\/superuser>/gi, '[filtered]') after the opening tag replace, or change the existing pattern to /<\/?superuser>/gi.

blockingIssues.description: The regex /\}{{3,}/g for collapsing 3+ consecutive closing braces is incorrect. It matches a literal '}' followed by 3+ '{' characters then '}', NOT 3+ consecutive '}' characters. The correct regex should be /\}{3,}/g. Current behavior: sanitizeBookmarkText('}}}}}}')

nonBlockingIssues.description: sanitizeFtsQuery() is purely a validator (returns input unchanged if valid), but the name 'sanitize' implies transformation. Minor naming concern.
nonBlockingIssues.suggestedFix: Consider renaming to validateFtsQuery() for accuracy, or documenting that it validates-and-passes-through.

nonBlockingIssues.description: validateDate() is placed in bookmarks-db.ts (database module) rather than a dedicated CLI validation module. Architecturally misplaced but pragmatically fine.
nonBlockingIssues.suggestedFix: Could move to a validation utility module if more CLI-level validations are added.

nonBlockingIssues.description: IPv6 private ranges (fc00::/7, fe80::/10) are not blocked. No DNS resolution check — syntactic-only validation doesn't prevent DNS rebinding.
nonBlockingIssues.suggestedFix: Add IPv6 private range blocking if needed. DNS resolution would require async, not desirable for this CLI tool.

nonBlockingIssues.description: Dead code remains in cli.ts: FRIENDLY_STOP_REASONS constant, friendlyStopReason(), and warnIfEmpty() were moved to sync-command.ts but originals not removed from cli.ts. Unused import of rebuildIndex in cli.ts.
nonBlockingIssues.suggestedFix: Remove the duplicated dead code from cli.ts and the unused rebuildIndex import.

nonBlockingIssues.description: GapfillState.processedIds typed as Set<string> but serialized/deserialized as Array. totalIds field is always empty (dead code). State file not cleaned up after successful full run.
nonBlockingIssues.suggestedFix: Change type to string[] for accuracy. Remove dead totalIds field. Consider state cleanup after completion.

nonBlockingIssues.description: Unnecessary callbackUrl check in refreshOAuthToken() (not needed for refresh_token grant type, but consistent with existing pattern). Minor duplicated refresh logic between withTokenRefresh() and inline pagination handler.
nonBlockingIssues.suggestedFix: Acceptable as-is given consistency with existing code patterns.
